filter_tests_by_changed_files: filter gRPC pull request tests to only run those relevant to changed files in the diff
check_c_cpp_changes: check if a pull request affects C or C++ code by comparing against the base branch
get_changed_files_between_branches: get the list of changed files between the current branch and a specified base branch using git
create_test_suite_with_triggers: create a TestSuite object with labels and add regex triggers to determine which file changes should run tests
determine_skippable_tests: determine if tests can be skipped by checking whether changed files match any of the test suite triggers
